about.title: About Legendary Arc-V Decks
paragraphs: Legendary Arc-V Decks is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG deck released on 6 August 2026, in the SEVENS & GO RUSH!! era. It has 115 cards, and with the 35 other rarities there are 150 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 115 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 150, adding the 35 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
